title: Update FAQ to answer the hard questions (prompt injection, 'isn't this just prompts?')
story: As a cautious buyer, I want direct answers to the obvious objections (prompt injection, 'just prompts', 'providers already do this') so I trust what I'm reading.
description: Add/adjust FAQ entries to explicitly address: 'Can prompts override constraints?', 'Is this just orchestration?', 'What is enforced in V1 vs V1.5?', 'What is Stux?'. Include crisp, non-hype answers.
acceptance_criteria: FAQ includes at least 4 new/updated questions covering the objections above.
Answers are concise, factual, and versioned (V1 vs V1.5).
No absolutes; no claims of perfect safety or immunity to injection.
